<thought>To calculate DBE for C9H7O4, retrieve the DBE formula then apply DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2. With C=9, H=7, N=0, X=0, DBE = (18+2-7)/2 = 13/2 = 6.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the nearest integer is 7 (rounding up). I'll provide 7 as the integer DBE.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
